meta.title: Pricing — Adapdev
meta.description: One-off licence pricing for ADMS across the three target business types: sole trader, small business, and small/medium law firm. No subscription, no per-document fee.

top.title: One licence per installation. Nothing per document.
top.description: ADMS is sold as a one-off licence per installation — one laptop for a sole trader, one office server for a small business or law firm. Twelve months of updates included; renewal is optional and keeps you on the latest release. No per-seat fee, no per-document charge, no cloud bill in US dollars.

card.title: Something else about pricing?
card.text: Email us and we'll reply the same working day.

items.a: Because the product is on your hardware and we don't want you paying rent on software that runs locally. The licence buys the installer, twelve months of updates, and support. After twelve months, ADMS keeps working — renewal is only needed to keep updates coming.

items.q: What is NOT in the price?
items.a: Hardware, Windows licences, SQL Server licences (small-business and law-firm tiers), ongoing backup media, and the cost of your own time setting ADMS up. For the Sole Trader tier on a laptop with the bundled SQLite, those 'extras' are typically zero.

items.q: Can we migrate between tiers later?
items.a: Yes. SQLite (sole-trader) data imports straight into a SQL Server (small-business or law-firm) install with a bundled migration tool — clients, matters, documents, permissions, audit log all intact.
Yes. We send a time-limited signed installer that runs the full product against a demo dataset for 30 days on your own hardware. No signup, no credit card.
